boot_boundary: 仅绑定一次请求后首次观察的新boot；volatile journal不能排除离线期间额外启动

argv:
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
script,expected,candidate,manifest,backup,tools=sys.argv[1:]
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(script).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
sys.path.insert(0,tools)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('frozen_installer',script)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
subject=module.S0UnitInstaller(Path(candidate),manifest)
path,record=subject._read_backup(Path(backup))
refs=[module.file_identity(path/name) for name in ('backup.json','backup.sha256')]
refs += [module.file_identity(ref['path']) for ref in record['saved'].values()]
print(json.dumps(dict(record=record,refs=refs)))
